page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with a running head at the top and an imprint line at the foot. No margin notes beside the text.

main_text.head: DISPUTATIONUM THEOLOGICARUM SECUNDA, DE UNIVERSALITATE ECCLESIÆ:
main_text.p: In qua prima pontificiorum ecclesiæ nota falsitatis convincitur; &, neque illam, quæ se sub CATHOLICÆ nomine venditat, illico catholicam ac veram Christi ecclesiam; neque hanc, quæ á certis hominibus, tanquam novorum dogmatum architectis, invidiose denominatur ac traducitur, statim hæreticam esse, perspicuè ostenditur:
main_text.head: IMMANUELE BENE JUVANTE,
LUDOVICI CROCII D. ET PROFESSORIS S. THEOLOGIÆ IN ILLUSTRI SCHOLA BREMENSI, pro viribus publicè respondebit
main_text.p: Gregor. de Valentia lib. 6. analyst c. 7.

p.i: Hæc nota, quas urgemus, UNA, SANCTA, CATHOLICA, & Apostolica non sunt notæ ecclesiæ sigillatim, sed conjunctim, quia fieri possit, ut una harum, & altera aliis conveniat.

page.notes: Several words in the scan are faded or blurred; the Latin above is a best reading. "Deo juvante" appears partly obscured by the ornamental initial and is uncertain. The first heading line may read "DE UNIVERSALITATE" in a larger display type. The imprint year is read as 1613. The "Dietyal" ornament near "Deo juvante" is a printer's sign and is not transcribed as text.
